architect_blocker.observed: Both Ubuntu jobs first passed the WORK_PATH_UNSAFE assertion, then failed only because unlink plus recreate immediately reused st_ino. Both macOS jobs passed all 1962 tests.
architect_blocker.root_cause: The fixture assumes an unlinked inode cannot be reused for the immediately recreated file. POSIX filesystems may reuse that inode once the old file has no live link or descriptor.
architect_blocker.security_assessment: Production rejection remained correct; the test must still prove a real distinct-identity replacement rather than remove or relax the security assertion.

Atomically install that already-distinct replacement with os.replace, then establish that the named target has the pre-observed replacement identity and byte-identical content.
Keep both command assertions at exit 2 and WORK_PATH_UNSAFE, and keep the blob/request publication assertions and zero-network checks.
Use exclusive non-following creation where supported or an equally deterministic same-directory mechanism; clean up any helper path on exceptional test exits.
